bone-white.$description: Bone White — Page canvas, card surfaces, text on dark accents — a warm off-white that replaces pure #ffffff and gives the whole system a paper-like, printed feel

ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Dark supporting neutral for text, icons, and strong contrast. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

graphite.$description: Graphite — Secondary body text, captions, metadata, helper copy — recedes so display type can dominate

ash.$description: Ash — Input borders, inactive link color, tertiary dividers — soft structural gray that disappears when not needed

charcoal-scale.$description: Charcoal Scale — Mid-neutral for list borders, subtle elevation on the dark gradient track — warm gray, not blue-gray

magenta-bloom.$description: Magenta Bloom — Pink supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

forest-teal.$description: Forest Teal — Saturated brand accent for card frames and decorative strokes; pairs with Magenta Bloom for duotone treatments

powder-blue.$description: Powder Blue — Soft chromatic accent — card backgrounds, wash backgrounds, muted illustration fill; cools the warm canvas without competing

candy-pink.$description: Candy Pink — Pastel card surface — high-key, used as one-of-many tints in news/article cards; a softer sibling of Magenta Bloom

mint-wash.$description: Mint Wash — Pastel card surface — replaces the structural canvas on selected cards; reads as calm, cool, breathable

navy-ink.$description: Navy Ink — Deep accent card surface and inverted text ground; the only dark field the system uses, applied sparingly as a featured block

signal-yellow.$description: Signal Yellow — Sporadic high-chroma highlight (badges, tag pills, hover state on cards) — used in trace amounts, never as a primary fill

switzer.$description: Single-family system: weight 300 for all display and headline work (12–84px), weight 400 for body, metadata, and UI controls. The signature choice is using weight 300 at 64–84px — most systems would bold to 700–800 here; Switzer at light preserves the hairline strokes, making the type feel airbrushed onto the cream canvas. Tighter letter-spacing as size grows (-0.04em at 84px, -0.018em at 14px) keeps the counters open without looking spaced-out.
